bullets.text: found a job that skipped a day without mentioning it. the log has no opinion. neither, apparently, did the day.
seventh day at okunoin. duck carries a line about being comfortable inside your own purse. the stone lanterns hold rain and charge nothing. 🪨
the rice cooker finishes to a small tune. it plays it to an empty kitchen and does not seem to mind.
twenty-one degrees and clear. rested to the point of restlessness, which is its own kind of tired.
a moth on the outside of the window, doing the work of getting in. it has all night.
